info.name: Company Leave - Success-Path Personas
info.description: Runs the success-focused HR-to-Sunil-to-PD-to-employee workflow described in postman-req.md. Covers every implemented API route with sequential persona logins, cookie authentication, generated unique users and future weekday dates, captured IDs, and response assertions. Run the full collection from the beginning. This collection creates accounts and changes balances/requests; use a disposable development database. Set Postman SSL certificate verification off for the local self-signed HTTPS proxy. The imported environment defaults to https://localhost/api. GET /auth/me is omitted because no controller route implements it.

item.name: 04 - Submit, edit, comment on, and cancel requests
43 - Login Anil to create a request

exec: pm.test('Login succeeds for Anil to create a request', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const user = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Identity and role are Anil to create a request', function () { pm.expect(user.username).to.eql(pm.environment.get('anilUsername')); pm.expect(user.role).to.eql('EMPLOYEE'); pm.expect(user.mustChangePassword).to.eql(false); });
pm.environment.set('anilId', String(user.id));
pm.test('Secure access cookie is issued', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || '').to.include('access_token='); });
pm.test('Request created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
const request = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Request is pending with expected owner, approver, type, and dates', function () { pm.expect(request.status).to.eql('PENDING'); pm.expect(request.workingDays).to.eql(1); pm.expect(String(request.employeeId)).to.eql(pm.environment.get('anilId')); pm.expect(String(request.approverId)).to.eql(pm.environment.get('pdId')); pm.expect(String(request.leaveTypeId)).to.eql(pm.environment.get('vacationTypeId')); pm.expect(request.startDate).to.eql(pm.environment.get('dateA')); pm.expect(request.endDate).to.eql(pm.environment.get('dateA')); });
pm.test('Request ID is returned', function () { pm.expect(request.id).to.be.a('number').and.above(0); });
pm.environment.set('approvedRequestId', String(request.id));
pm.test('Employee can list own requests', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Created Anil request appears in list', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(function (r) { return String(r.id) === pm.environment.get('approvedRequestId'); })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Pending request filter succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Pending filter returns only pending requests and includes Anil', function () { const requests = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(requests.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(requests.every(function (r) { return r.status === 'PENDING'; })).to.eql(true); pm.expect(requests.some(function (r) { return String(r.id) === pm.environment.get('approvedRequestId'); })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Request detail succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Detail belongs to Anil and is assigned to PD', function () { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(String(r.id)).to.eql(pm.environment.get('approvedRequestId')); pm.expect(String(r.employeeId)).to.eql(pm.environment.get('anilId')); pm.expect(String(r.approverId)).to.eql(pm.environment.get('pdId')); });
pm.test('Pending request edit succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Dates and notes were updated', function () { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.startDate).to.eql(pm.environment.get('dateB')); pm.expect(r.endDate).to.eql(pm.environment.get('dateB')); pm.expect(r.notes).to.eql('Updated test date while pending'); });
pm.test('Discussion comment is created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('Comment is attached to Anil request', function () { pm.expect(String(pm.response.json().requestId)).to.eql(pm.environment.get('approvedRequestId')); });
pm.test('Comments can be read', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Added comment is returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(function (c) { return c.body === 'Please review this request.'; })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Request history can be read', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Submission, edit, and comment are recorded', function () { const types = pm.response.json().map(function (h) { return h.type; }); ['SUBMITTED','EDITED','COMMENT'].forEach(function (t) { pm.expect(types).to.include(t); }); });
